Quality phrase rules and narrow positive check remain unchanged; other quality cases explicitly remain UNDETERMINED.
Relationship clarifications identify text-supported possible interactions; no confirmed conflict is inferred from unequal minima or unspecified override scope.
Document checks search the named sections and recognize explicit headings/phrases; absence findings concern SRS guidance, not NASA project noncompliance.
SWE-051 uses visible analysis-input context only. SWE-053/054/055 process performance is NOT_ASSESSABLE from the SRS and requires external records.
All project compliance remains NOT_DETERMINED. A complete report structure does not certify complete quality, safety, analysis, validation or implementation correctness.
No holdout labels are read and no holdout accuracy is determined; public calibration scores must be evaluated separately after prediction.
Core NPR section references were checked against bundled NPR 7150.2D page32; current controlled-standard applicability and tailoring need human review.

| MN-06 | The pilot must be informed of spacecraft failures. |
| MN-07 | The spacecraft must support safe operation during emergencies. |
| MN-08 | The mission computer must remain operational throughout a mission. |
| MN-09 | Mission events must be recorded for later analysis. |
| MN-10 | Unauthorized users must not be able to control the spacecraft. |
